description: In SolveSpace, create a new file and draw a circle with a specific radius constraint. In the blank canvas, use the circle drawing tool (Sketch > Circle) to draw a circle. Then add a radius or diameter constraint (Constrain > Distance / Diameter) to set the radius to exactly 25 mm. The circle should be placed in the default XY workplane. Save the file as '/home/ga/Documents/SolveSpace/circle.slvs' using File > Save.
